title: Migrate hass-pi-agent local project DB → issues tracker + wiki

todos.description: Confirm release version scheme + epic-less issue handling
Create + bind @hass-pi-agent issues project to anchor
Enable release management + create 10 releases (one per epic, chronological)
Backfill 40 issues, assign to release, close the 39 done
Onboard anchor into wiki (My Software / MSW)
Build wiki releases index + one page per epic-release; link from MSWNJA34
Migrate 10 assets into wiki pages with category tags
Cross-link wiki docs from issues + verify counts

body:
## Goal
Migrate the local `.pi/project/database.json` (10 epics, 40 issues, 10 assets, 4 categories) into:
- **Issues tracker** (dkmaker @issues backend) — new bound project for backfilled issues
- **Wiki** — assets (architecture/patterns/policies/workflows) as durable docs

## Source inventory (`.pi/project/database.json` v9)
- **10 epics** (all closed): Docker add-on, CI/GHCR, Release flow, .storage audit, History tools, Custom component, Phase1 core tools, Phase2 config mgmt, Phase3 extended, Output formatting
- **40 issues** (39 closed, 1 draft): `or7ff70u Install MQTT client tools` is the only open one
- **10 assets**: VM Testing Workflow, Add-on Architecture, Release/Version Policy, Pi Extension Architecture, Schema Extraction Workflow, New Tool Implementation Pattern, WebSocket Collection CRUD Pattern, HA REST API Patterns, Extension Reload policy, Tool Output Formatting Standard
- **4 categories**: workflows, architecture, policies, patterns

## CONFIRMED approach (user decisions)
### Issues tracker — release-based
- Create project `@hass-pi-agent`, bind anchor `031b3156-8eaf-4548-8fe6-db3117cc048f`
- **Enable release management** on the project
- **Each of the 10 epics → a release** (chronological). Release version/title from epic title; release notes = epic description + success criteria.
- Backfill all 40 issues into the tracker, each assigned/linked to its epic's release; close the 39 done, leave `or7ff70u` open.
- 2 epic-less issues (`mq72ge34`, plus the standalone ones with epicId None) → handle as no-release or a "misc" release.

### Wiki — under My Software (MSW)
- Project index already exists: WIKI#MSWNJA34 (slug `hass-pi-agent`).
- **Dedicated releases area:** one releases-index page (chronological table of all epic-releases) + one page per epic-release.
- Link releases-index from the project index MSWNJA34.
- 10 assets → wiki pages in MSW, tagged by category (workflows/architecture/policies/patterns) + `hass-pi-agent`; linked from project index.
- Onboard anchor into wiki.

## Open detail
- Epic-less issues: park under a "Misc / ungrouped" release or leave release-less. Default: leave release-less.
- Release version scheme: sequential `v0.1`…`v0.10` by epic order, or date-based. Default: sequential by epic array order.
